topics.fancy_title: Can email server settings be made configurable for easy modification?
topics.title: 电子邮件服务器设置可以做成随时可以修改的配置吗？
topics.excerpt: I recently ran into a situation where my email service account was suddenly disabled by the provider, forcing me to switch to a different email service. I can't update the email server configuration on the fly; instead, I have to modify the app.yaml configuration and rebuild to apply the changes. This causes the website to go offline for a few minutes, which is unacceptable during daytime hours. Meanwhile, the number of failed emails sent during this time is steadily increasing, which is really frustrating.
